label: Export As…

label: Delete Filter Mask
shortcut: {"layer":id?,"ifPresent":bool=false (true: a smart object without a filter mask is left as it is, as a Photoshop action's step needs where Photoshop added the mask by default)}

label: Add Vector Mask
